Call.description: Params and result types of one method.

Call2.description: Params and result types of one method.

ClientInfo.description: Name and version of the host, for the plugin's diagnostics only.

Comment.description: A comment of the file. Adjacent line comments are one comment.

attached_to.description: Id of the symbol the comment is the documentation of, when known.

text.description:
Source text including the comment markers (`//`, `/* */`, `#`); the
lines of one comment are joined by `\n`.

Context.description: Host-side settings that accompany an index request.

options.description: Per-language options from `[languages.<id>]`, keyed by language id.

Conventions.description: Layout conventions of a language that the host cannot infer from its files.

Edge.description: A directed relation between two code-model nodes.

to.description:
A module path, a symbol id, or a kind-less symbol id
(`module::owner::name`) that names exactly one symbol.

EdgeKind.description: The relation an edge states between its endpoints.

FileInfo.description: Identity and classification of an indexed file.

FileRef.description: A file to index; the plugin reads its content from disk.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the file content, lowercase hex.

Flow.description:
A control-flow construct and the number of enclosing nesting constructs,
nested functions included, around it.

arms.description: `switch`: arms other than the default arm.

returning.description: `switch`: every arm, default included, is a single return.

FlowKind.description: Normalized control-flow construct, the same for every language.

comments.description:
Comments of the file in source order. Added in 0.1 before 1.0; a
plugin that does not know comments omits the field.

FunctionSummary.description: Size and shape measures of one function or method, keyed by its symbol id.

clone_fingerprint.description: Reserved: normalized fingerprint for clone detection.

forwards_to.description:
Target of the call the body consists of when it passes the receiver and
every parameter on, in order.

manual_assertions.description:
Checks of a test file's function written out by hand: an `if` that
compares and whose only effect is to fail the test. Added in 0.1
before 1.0; zero when the plugin does not count them.

max_nesting.description: Deepest level of nested constructs; a flat body is 0.

param_types.description:
Project types named by the parameters, receiver excluded, as kind-less
symbol ids (`module::name`). Added in 0.1 before 1.0; empty when the
plugin does not resolve parameter types.

top_level.description: Statements directly in the body, not in nested blocks.

Incomplete.description: Part of the request that was not analyzed; "not checked" is not "passed".

path.description: Project-relative path; absent when the gap is not tied to one file.

IndexParams.description:
Index request. A provider receives every file of one language in one
request and decides which packages or modules it must load to analyze
them; analysis scope is never narrowed to a subset of the project.

language.description: Id of the language the files belong to.

IndexResult.description:
A plugin's answer to `index`: one fragment per analyzed file plus what could
not be analyzed. A file is never silently dropped.

fragments.description: One fragment per analyzed file, ordered by path.

incomplete.description:
Files or scopes that could not be analyzed. A file listed here may
still have a fragment with whatever could be recovered.

notices.description: Messages that leave the analysis complete.

InitializeParams.description:
First request, sent by the host. Fields of protocol messages are camelCase;
fields of the code model are snake_case.

root.description: Absolute path of the project root.

InitializeResult.description:
A plugin's answer to `initialize`: who it is, which protocol it speaks, and
the languages it indexes.

id.description: Plugin id; must equal the `id` of its `lighthouse-plugin.toml`.

protocolVersion.description: Must equal the host's protocol version.

Language.description: A language a plugin indexes and how the host routes files to it.

capabilities.description: Known value: `semantic-edges`. Hosts ignore unknown values.

fallback.description: A fallback language claims a file only when no other language does.

globs.description:
Project-relative path globs; `*` and `?` never cross `/`, a `**`
component matches any number of directories.

priority.description: Among providers matching a file, the higher priority wins.

Module.description: Package, directory or namespace; `path` identifies it project-wide.

name.description: Name the language gives the module, such as a Go package name.

test_of.description: Path of the module whose public surface this one tests from outside.

Node.description: An edge endpoint: a whole module or one symbol.

Overlay.description:
Reserved: the content of an unsaved file. Hosts do not send overlays in
0.1; providers read files from disk.

Position.description: 1-based line and column; the column counts bytes.

ProjectRef.description: The project an index request belongs to.

root.description: Absolute path of the project root.

Resolution.description: How reliable an edge's target is.

oneOf.description: The target comes from type information.
The target comes from names alone.

A guess: the edge says the source may use the target, never that it
does. Analyzers that count calls or dependencies ignore such edges; a
rule asking whether something might be used may honor them.

Symbol.description: A named declaration; `id` is unique across the project.

file.description: Project-relative path of the declaring file.

owner.description: Id of the enclosing type or interface.

role.description:
Set on the declarations of test files whose purpose the language can
tell; test entry points are `test` symbols and carry none.

SymbolKind.description: What a symbol declares; the kebab-case name is the `#kind` suffix of its id.

SymbolRole.description:
What a declaration of a test file is for. Added in 0.1 before 1.0; a
plugin that cannot tell omits it.

oneOf.description:
Test code that checks on behalf of tests, such as a function that takes
the test framework's handle.

Test data and code that builds it: types, constants, variables and
functions that need no handle.

TestCase.description: A test symbol and the symbols it exercises.

targets.description: Symbols the test calls or references, as edge targets.

TestStyle.description: How a test enumerates its cases: one body over a data table, or separate scenarios.

Visibility.description:
Who may use a symbol, as its language defines it; `internal` means visible
within a bounded unit such as a crate, not outside it.

description: Every method with its params and result. Exists to anchor the schema.
title: Methods
